system.description:
The source of your powers is the result of your hard work, dedication, and long hours.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.CjqhY7vBfkJQyhw4]{Gadgets}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Intellectual powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.1xx6Rm1oWVEf7cuY]{Always Be Prepared}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.irLsZNE2hqDWW3B6]{Reactive Field}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.CBzx0lk7CrKoKXJP]{Flowing Fight}
Additional Info

When you move to the next step, select an extra quality from that archetype's list at d8.

Archetype

Roll d10, d8, d8 for archetype selection.
